payload.question: How many private homes did the council help insulate?
payload.label: Private sector insulation measures completed, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council's own explanation: "This figure is at zero for quarter one 2025/2026 pending commencement of delivery for the Warm Homes: Local Grant. This grant funding totalling £4.7m will be used to deliver private sector energy efficiency and insulation measures to an estimated 330 private sector homes over the three-year period to March 2028, with delivery set to commence imminently in quarter two 2025/2026." The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council marks this indicator red, and has for five quarters running: the reported figure is zero in every quarter from Q1 2024/25 to Q1 2025/26. It is one of the four indicators the council's own report names as needing intervention. Our rule cannot put a colour on it, because the council's dashboard prints the intervention level of 45 but not the target, and we do not invent the missing half of a comparison. Grey here means the record cannot answer the question, not that nothing is wrong.
